description: Header file defining macros, function prototypes, and includes for quantization of pitch and codebook gains in AMR speech codec (specifically for MR475 mode).

methods.name: MR475_update_unq_pred
methods.description: Updates the unquantized gain predictor with the bounded prediction error using the optimal codebook gain.

methods.name: MR475_gain_quant
methods.description: Performs quantization of pitch and codebook gains for two subframes using predicted codebook gain.
